title: FY 2025 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP (AARO, 20 Jul 2026)
doc_notes: This is an annual report from the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) covering UAP reporting trends and analysis, containing one specific encounter report.

encounters.summary: A U.S. Navy report described approximately 100 airborne UAP and two uncrewed surface systems operating off the coast of Virginia.
